items.title: PatchCraft Launcher v2.0.0
items.summary: Forge Rail & Direct Character Roster UI: Rebuilt the desktop and Steam Deck shell around a 3-column layout with a collapsible left rail (RuneScape 3, Old School, Dragonwilds, World Ping, Live Logs,...

sections.heading: Added
bullets: **Forge Rail & Direct Character Roster UI**: Rebuilt the desktop and Steam Deck shell around a 3-column layout with a collapsible left rail (`RuneScape 3`, `Old School`, `Dragonwilds`, `World Ping`, `Live Logs`, `Resources`, `Community`, and `Settings`) and a pinned launch panel with per-character Play/Stop controls, inline Active Clients, and clickable `MEM`/`F2P` overrides.

**Built-In Theme Presets**: Added three offline-first theme presets in Settings -> General (`PatchCraft`, `Obsidian & Brass`, and `Slate & Teal`) using native system typography with zero external font dependencies.
**In-App Community Hub & Discussions**: Added inline `Community` workspace tabs for Launcher News, live GitHub Discussions browsing and replies, and direct issue reporting.
**Expanded Curated Resources**: Added resource logos and expanded community tool directories for RuneScape 3, Old School RuneScape, and Dragonwilds.

sections.heading: Changed
bullets: **PatchCraft Launcher Rebrand**: Renamed package slugs, desktop IDs (`dev.patchcraft.launcher`), CLI command (`patchcraft-launcher`), and runtime paths while preserving legacy `linux-jagex-launcher` CLI symlinks and upgrade compatibility.

**Inline Workspace Tools & Settings**: Moved World Ping, Live Logs, Resources, Community, and Settings & Doctor out of overlay modals into full workspace views with updated gamepad navigation (`LB`/`RB` and `X`/`Y`/`A`/`B`/`Start`).
**Website & Documentation**: Updated `https://launcher.patchcraft.dev/` with fresh v2.0.0 desktop screenshots and synced release feeds.

sections.heading: Fixed
bullets:
**Dragonwilds Steam Patch Feed**: Decoded XML entities before stripping HTML markup so raw `

` tags no longer appear in Steam news cards.
**External Protocol Links**: Allowed `steam://` links alongside `http://` and `https://` in external link handling for Steam Deck on-screen keyboard and Dragonwilds launches.
**Resources SVG Rendering**: Fixed trusted inline SVG icons in the Resources view rendering as escaped text instead of vector icons.
**Login Window Lifecycle**: Resolved embedded Jagex login promises cleanly when the login window is closed or already open, and kept the login user-agent aligned with the bundled Chromium version.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: **Thanks for your patience**: Sorry for the radio silence — I recently lost power and internet access for a few days. My sincerest apologies for the delay in response. Between v1.4.8 (targeted bug fixes), v1.4.9 (general fixes), and v1.5.0 (major codebase reorganization and backend improvements), development continues smoothly. Huge thanks to everyone using the launcher!

items.title: Arch (.pacman) & Fedora (.rpm) Packages Hosted Directly on GitHub Releases
items.summary: Native Arch Linux (.x64.pacman) and Fedora/RHEL (.x86_64.rpm) packages alongside AppImage, .deb, and portable .tar.gz archives are hosted directly on every GitHub Release.

sections.heading: Highlights
bullets: **Arch Linux**: Install the `.x64.pacman` package from GitHub Releases using `sudo pacman -U` or build locally via `packaging/aur/PKGBUILD`.
**Fedora & RHEL**: Install the `.x86_64.rpm` package directly with `sudo dnf install -y` from GitHub Releases.
**Verified Checksums**: Every release publishes `SHA256SUMS.txt` verified automatically by the built-in launcher updater.

items.title: PatchCraft Launcher v1.4.8
items.summary: Legacy Jagex APT Repository Detection & One-Click Remediation: Added automatic detection and guided one-click cleanup for Jagex's deprecated Ubuntu 14.04 (trusty) APT repository, resolving signature and...

sections.heading: Added
bullets: **Legacy Jagex APT Repository Detection & One-Click Remediation**: Added automatic detection and guided one-click cleanup for Jagex's deprecated Ubuntu 14.04 (`trusty`) APT repository, resolving signature and `NO_PUBKEY` APT update errors on Ubuntu 24.04 LTS and Ubuntu 26.04 LTS ("Resolute Raccoon") in RS3 Doctor, OSRS Doctor, Issue Reporter, and `install.sh`.

sections.heading: Fixed
bullets: **Ubuntu 24.04 & 26.04 (`resolute`) `t64` Package Resolution**: Updated RS3 Doctor, OSRS Doctor, and Debian repository metadata to resolve modern 64-bit `time_t` (`t64`) library packages on Ubuntu 24.04+, Ubuntu 26.04 LTS, Linux Mint 22+, Pop!_OS 24.04+, and Debian 13+, while retaining compatibility on Ubuntu 22.04 and Debian 12.
**RS3 CDN Diagnostic Probe & OSRS Repair Fixes**: Updated the RS3 network diagnostic probe to check the active client package index and fixed home-directory path expansion in OSRS permissions repair.

**Standalone Debian Installer Resiliency (`install.sh`)**: Prevented broken third-party APT repositories from aborting local `.deb` package installation and enabled fast HTTP error detection on release downloads.

**Official Website UI, Responsive Layout & Accessibility Overhaul**: Removed the redundant macOS traffic-light titlebar stacked above the launcher's native Linux window frame, added a responsive mobile navigation popover menu, implemented accessible installation tabs with find-in-page auto-switching and scroll-edge fades, fixed code-block horizontal overflow and copy-button race conditions, corrected the Fedora Copr repository command (`cook0001/linux-jagex-launcher`), and added explicit image dimensions + LCP priority hints to eliminate layout shift.

items.summary: Debian & PPA Package Relationships: Declared explicit Replaces, Conflicts, and Provides relationships between jagex-launcher and linux-jagex-launcher, resolving dpkg file overwrite and upgrade collisions;...

sections.heading: Fixed
bullets: **Debian & PPA Package Relationships**: Declared explicit `Replaces`, `Conflicts`, and `Provides` relationships between `jagex-launcher` and `linux-jagex-launcher`, resolving dpkg file overwrite and upgrade collisions.

**AUR Binary Execution & Symlink Paths**: Corrected target binary installation path in the AUR package and added symlinks in `/usr/bin` for both `linux-jagex-launcher` and `jagex-launcher` for immediate command-line execution.
**Launchpad PPA Version Synchronization**: Bumped upstream release version to v1.4.4 to generate clean Debian source artifacts and resolve Launchpad PPA checksum conflicts.

items.title: PatchCraft Launcher v1.4.3
items.summary: HiDPI Display Scaling Controls for OSRS: Configurable UI scaling (1.0x to 3.0x) for crisp high-resolution rendering on 4K, 1440p, and high-density laptop displays; Multi-Instance Client Manager: Live...

sections.heading: Added
bullets: **HiDPI Display Scaling Controls for OSRS**: Configurable UI scaling (`1.0x` to `3.0x`) for crisp high-resolution rendering on 4K, 1440p, and high-density laptop displays.
**Multi-Instance Client Manager**: Live tracking and management for multiple concurrent RuneLite, HDOS, and RS3 game clients with live process heartbeats and individual force-stop/kill controls.
**In-App Live Client Log Viewer**: Dedicated real-time terminal modal with ring-buffered streaming, level coloring, log source filters, token sanitization, and text export.
**Multi-GPU & Dedicated GPU Selector**: Automatic hardware detection of integrated and discrete GPUs with one-click Mesa and NVIDIA PRIME GPU offloading.
**Deep Link OAuth Protocol Handling**: Seamless authentication callback interception for `jagex://` and `jagex-launcher://` URLs on running instances and cold start.

sections.heading: Fixed
bullets: **Custom Launch Command Template Expansion**: Fixed quoted argument tokenization in `%command%` launch wrappers for tools like `gamemoderun`, `mangohud`, and `gamescope`.
**Process Lifecycle & PID Recycling Safeguards**: Added strict process identity checks before signaling child processes and safely pruned exited instances.

**Harmless Desktop Warning Classification**: Automatically categorized non-fatal desktop subsystem notices (`canberra-gtk-module`, `pk-gtk-module`, `ALSA`, `LWJGL`, `WARNING:`) as warnings rather than red errors.
**Network Resilience Timeouts**: Added request timeouts across authentication, update checking, and client download operations to prevent UI hangs on stalled connections.
**Steam Shortcut Key Indexing**: Fixed sequential key generation in `shortcuts.vdf` to prevent key collisions with existing non-Steam shortcuts.
**Release Parity**: Synchronized all packaging formats across AppImage, Flatpak, Snap, Debian PPA, and AUR to v1.4.3.

items.title: PatchCraft Launcher v1.4.2
items.summary: AppImage Child Environment Isolation & RuneLite Launch Loop: Isolated AppImage runtime variables when launching game clients so RuneLite no longer misidentifies the launcher AppImage as its own bundle and...

sections.heading: Fixed
bullets: **AppImage Child Environment Isolation & RuneLite Launch Loop**: Isolated AppImage runtime variables when launching game clients so RuneLite no longer misidentifies the launcher AppImage as its own bundle and exits early.
**RuneLite & OSRS Process Lifecycle Tracking**: Improved process tracking across launcher-to-client handoff so game-running status persists smoothly after the bootstrap jar exits.
**OpenJDK 24+ ZGC Compatibility**: Automatically adjusts ZGC flags on OpenJDK 24+ where generational ZGC is enabled by default.
**AppImage FUSE2-Free Static Runtime**: Switched to a static AppImage runtime to run seamlessly on Ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04 without requiring legacy `libfuse.so.2`.

**Application Menu Launching & Stale Desktop Override Resolution**: Resolved working-directory assumptions when creating `.desktop` entries and cleaned up stale user desktop overrides that shadowed system binaries.
**Single-Instance Lock & Window Focus**: Enforced single-instance locking so re-opening the launcher from the application menu restores and focuses the existing window instead of spawning duplicates.
**Wayland Window Presentation & Compatibility**: Added secondary window presentation fallbacks and display surface compatibility tuning across Wayland and X11 compositors.
**Application Menu Category Conformance**: Corrected desktop entry categories to standard `Game;` ensuring consistent placement across GNOME, KDE Plasma, and XFCE application menus.

sections.heading: Added
bullets: **Canonical Snap Release Pipeline**: Added full Snap package build and distribution support targeting `core24` with strict confinement, full hardware/audio/storage plugs, and persistent data storage across snap auto-refreshes.
**In-App Snap Format Detection**: Added native Snap package recognition to the auto-updater and runtime directory layout.

**Asynchronous OSRS Network Diagnostics**: Hardened background diagnostic probes against unhandled timeout rejections during network drops.

sections.heading: Changed

**Website Organization & Visual Polish**: Re-architected the project website with centered block containers, comfortable side padding, left-aligned typography, official game crests, and anonymous screenshots.

items.title: PatchCraft Launcher v1.4.0
items.summary: Native Linux System Tray Support: Added system tray integration with right-click context menu, fast character launch shortcuts, background minimize toggle, and persistent tray status; Quick Shortcuts &...

sections.heading: Added
bullets: **Native Linux System Tray Support**: Added system tray integration with right-click context menu, fast character launch shortcuts, background minimize toggle, and persistent tray status.

**Quick Shortcuts & Client Folders Hub**: Added quick-open shortcuts in Settings to easily locate screenshots, logs, and game caches for RuneLite (`~/.runelite`), RuneScape 3 (`~/.local/share/Jagex`), and HDOS (`~/.hdos`).

**Desktop Shortcuts & Icon Re-Registration**: Added utility button in Settings to safely recreate or repair `.desktop` application launchers and multi-resolution icons (`16x16` up to `1024x1024`) for Linux Jagex Launcher, RuneLite, HDOS, and the Official OSRS client.

**Official Launchpad Ubuntu PPA**: Full support for Ubuntu 26.04 LTS (`resolute`), Ubuntu 24.04 LTS (`noble`), and Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (`jammy`) via `ppa:danielcook2016/linux-jagex-launcher` with automated Launchpad cloud builds.
**Bit-for-Bit Reproducible Source Packaging**: Added deterministic Debian source package generation and automated GPG signing for PPA releases.
**Flathub & AppStream Compliance**: Updated AppStream metainfo specification to satisfy 100% of Flathub Quality Guidelines with zero validation warnings.

sections.heading: Changed
bullets: Re-architected Debian packaging rules to install dual desktop entries and multi-resolution application icons.
Updated automated updater to handle in-place AppImage updates with SHA-256 verification and distribution-aware notifications.

items.title: PatchCraft Launcher v1.3.0
items.summary: World Latency & Ping Prober: Concurrently probes active RuneScape 3 (Worlds 1–141) and Old School RuneScape (Worlds 301–599) servers in ~1.2 seconds with regional filtering and color-coded latency badges;...

sections.heading: Added
bullets: **World Latency & Ping Prober**: Concurrently probes active RuneScape 3 (Worlds 1–141) and Old School RuneScape (Worlds 301–599) servers in ~1.2 seconds with regional filtering and color-coded latency badges.
**Standalone Ping CLI Tools**: Added parallel Bash scripts (`rs3-ping.sh` and `osrs-ping.sh`) for headless terminal benchmarking.
**Community Resources & Tools Directory**: Built-in player tool hub supporting RuneScape 3, Old School RuneScape, and RuneScape: Dragonwilds (including RuneKit, Alt1, PvME, and GE Tracker).

**Older Linux Hardware & Low-Spec Performance Mode**: GPU optimization mode disabling heavy visual blurs and continuous animations, forcing hardware acceleration on older GPUs, and optimizing OSRS memory limits on low-RAM systems.
**Mesa Compatibility & DRI Fallback**: Integrated settings toggles for OpenGL compatibility mode and legacy DRI driver fallbacks.

bullets: **Initial Stable Release**: Native 64-bit Linux execution of RuneScape 3 NXT with zero Wine/Proton overhead.
